result.summary: Found 3 issues: one major content/localization bug and two major layout issues with truncated or cut-off content.

issues.description: Section heading displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the intended user-facing text (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Update the localization file or string resource so the correct translated title is rendered.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is truncated; the name appears as 'Trattoria Piccol' with the rest cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container provides enough padding/width so full card content is visible, or confirm peek behavior and truncate text with ellipsis if intentional.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza image with '-20%' badge) is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, hiding its name, rating, and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the scroll view bottom inset/padding so the last card is fully visible above the bottom navigation bar.
